questions.q: When is a group workshop generally more effective than a one-on-one interview?
options: When a process crosses multiple departments and conflicts need to surface early
When only one stakeholder understands the process
When the Executive Sponsor wants a private briefing
When no requirements have been identified yet
questions.explain: Workshops bring multiple stakeholders together so conflicts between departments surface immediately, which matters most for cross-department processes.

questions.q: What role does the scribe play in a requirements workshop?
options: Approves the project budget
Performs the Oracle Fusion configuration
Signs off on the solution design document
Captures decisions and requirement IDs in real time
questions.explain: The scribe's job is to capture decisions and requirement IDs as the workshop happens, not after the fact.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a "parking lot" during a workshop?
options: To schedule the next bank statement import
To track off-topic or unresolved items without derailing the agenda
To store configuration packages between environments
To log defect severity levels
questions.explain: A parking lot captures tangents or unresolved items so the group feels heard, with an owner assigned, while keeping the main agenda on track.

questions.q: Why does sign-off matter after a workshop or interview?
options: It is required before Oracle will issue a Service Request number
It replaces the need for a Requirements Traceability Matrix
It gives stakeholders a chance to catch a misunderstanding before it becomes a funded design decision
It is only needed for technical requirements, not business requirements
questions.explain: Sign-off confirms the written-up requirements accurately reflect what was discussed, catching misunderstandings early rather than during a costly later phase.

questions.q: What gap did Brightfield's Cash Management workshop surface?
options: The Executive Sponsor was unavailable
Wire transfers were being manually matched across three regional accounts in a spreadsheet
The legal entity structure was undefined
The project charter had not been signed
questions.explain: The workshop revealed that wire transfers were matched manually across three regional accounts in a spreadsheet — a process that doesn't map directly onto Oracle's automatic reconciliation rules.
